title: AutoSkip for YouTube
enableWatcherDesc: Automatically clicks the 'Skip' button when it appears in YouTube videos - does not remove ads
notificationDelayDesc: Set how long to wait before showing the notification
selectorsStale: YouTube may have changed its layout — the Skip button was not found during a long ad. An update may be required.
skipModeOffDesc: The extension never touches the Skip button. Mute and blur keep working.
skipModeAssistDesc: Highlights the Skip button the moment it appears — you click it yourself. No extra permission.
skipModeAutoDesc: Clicks the Skip button for you. A browser notice may briefly appear at the top of the tab — this is normal and expected.
skipModePermissionBody: When we click the Skip button for you, a notice may appear briefly at the top of the tab saying the extension is using the browser's debugging tool — that is completely normal and expected, and has nothing to do with your privacy or device security. You'll only see it for a moment during each skip, and you can switch back to Assist at any time from the same place.
skipModeFallbackNotice: A temporary problem occurred — please try again.
skipModeReturnReminder: Reminder: A browser notice will briefly appear during automatic skipping.
